question: Should this maintainer-labeled refactor make the extracted message-visibility and delivery-evidence helpers the canonical contract for both live subagent delivery and restart recovery?
rationale: The change deliberately centralizes semantics across session recovery, outbound delivery, and plugin-harness routing; the protected maintainer label requires a human decision on that shared ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve canonical ownership
options.body: Accept the shared helpers as the single delivery-evidence contract after reviewing the refreshed merge result and focused coverage for live delivery and recovery.

options.title: Keep recovery semantics local
options.body: Split only the proven common primitives if maintainers want restart recovery to retain an independently owned terminal-message policy.
